cases.title: Proposal selection opens the correct route for each proposal type
steps: Open the Master QCS view for the project with the draft proposal.
Click the vendor proposal in "QA_Platform Vendor 1 1790820862139".
Repeat with the project containing the non-draft proposal.
Repeat with the project containing the non-draft contract proposal.
cases.expected: The draft proposal opens `/awarding/:id?lotNo=`. The non-draft proposal opens `/project/:id/proposal/:proposalUuid?lotNo=`. The non-draft contract opens `/contract-details?contracts_uuids=`.
cases.setup: Prepare three equivalent projects: one with a draft proposal, one with a non-draft proposal, and one with a non-draft contract proposal.
gaps: Select or switch between the three distinct prepared projects containing the draft, non-draft, and non-draft contract proposals.
Prove that each prepared project has the stated proposal type before clicking the vendor proposal.
